fields.countryHelp: It dates your checks and places your contributions in the country ranking.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.sent: An e-mail was just sent to {{email}}. Open the link it contains within 24 hours to finish signing up.
signUp.notReceived: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, then start again.

stacks.title: Your stacks
stacks.intro: Optional. They help us show the itineraries that matter to you. You can change them in the settings.
stacks.newsletterHelp: A confirmation e-mail is sent before any issue.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the address of your account. We will send a link that works for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link was just sent to it. It expires in 30 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.intro: Choose a new password. Your other sessions will be closed.
reset.done: Your password is changed and your other sessions are closed. Log in with the new one.
reset.missing: This link carries no reset token. Ask for a new one.

confirm.title: Sign-up confirmation
confirm.invalid: This confirmation link is no longer valid. Sign up again: a new link will be sent to you.
confirm.taken: This address already has an account, perhaps created with this same link. Log in.
